# OpenCodeMarkdown

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.OpenCode` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/OpenCode/OpenCodeMarkdown.cs#L23)

Turns the agent's markdown into UI Toolkit elements.
Models answer in markdown whether asked to or not, and shown raw it is noise - fences,
asterisks and pipes around the content. This covers the subset replies actually use:
headings, lists, quotes, fenced code, tables, and inline code, bold, italic and links.
Labels in UI Toolkit parse rich-text tags, so any literal angle bracket in the source - a
generic type, an HTML snippet - is wrapped in noparse. Without that "List&lt;b>" silently
loses its tag and the rest of the paragraph turns bold.

### MaxLabelChars {#maxlabelchars}

Longest text a single label is given. A label is one mesh with a hard vertex limit, and a
tool that prints a whole file would otherwise blow through it and draw nothing at all.
